facts.fact: The Herald says the National ICT Policy (2022-2027) requires Government digital platforms to progressively meet international accessibility standards, and that advocates see few enforceable standards.

Permanent Secretary Kunaka says Government has set a target that by 2027 all new public service digital platforms comply with minimum accessibility standards, and that pre-procurement accessibility assessments are under discussion.
The Ministry of Health and Child Care launched the National Assistive Technology Strategy and the Assistive Products Priority List in May 2024.

Permanent Secretary Kunaka says Government, with ministries and partners, is implementing programmes that provide hearing aids, visual aids and other assistive technologies, with no number reached given.
